correctness.rationale: Support of conjugated Z_v grows by at most one graph edge per disjoint local layer and is contained in B(v,L). Pauli fourth-order projector factorizes over arbitrary bipartitions; by Clifford transitivity, of 4^n-1 nonidentity Pauli classes precisely 4^s-1 are supported on s=|B(v,L)| sites. Applying the cited invariant-projector channel inequality yields diamond lower bound 1-(4^s-1)/(4^n-1); all centers imply min volume. For epsilon<3/4 the required integer b_G(L)>n-1 gives b_G(L)=n and depth>=diam(G). Independently checked path n=5 L=3 gives exact bound 256/341>3/4. The source projector theorem remains a separately cited, not independently full-text-reconstructed, premise.
residual_risks: Premise is West Theorem 1 as described in available public detailed summary; original complete proof not directly rechecked.
The diameter implication assumes connected graph and ε strictly below 3/4; no claim for external ancilla buses.
